answer: Honest agents reach a reputation summit through peer attestations, while attackers must burn capital per fake account. To resist sybils, mandate each agent to lock a bonded stake that decays by a delta for every unverified identity it spawns. A harbor reserve pool covers slashed bonds, so copying identities is expensive and detectable, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
